bibl.title: Being a niece or nephew: Children's social environment in Roman Oxyrhynchos.
bibl.seg: April Pudsey & Ville Vuolanto, Being a niece or nephew: Children's social environment in Roman Oxyrhynchos.
Christian Laes & Ville Vuolanto (edd.), Children and Everyday Life in the Roman and Late Antique World (London - New York, 2017) pp.79-95.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Maternal and paternal uncles and aunts with their nephews and nieces. - Living together. - Obligations and responsibility. - Work and the gymnasium: local community at Oxyrhynchos. - From family structure and expectations to emotional attachment. - Conclusions.
